Hi Elsie — thanks for reaching out and for the clear details. I can help shepherd this. To proceed we need:

1) A signed authorization from someone on Ember's legal/compliance team (PDF).
2) The exact conversation identifier that shows up in your console or audit exports (you provided conv-id 77531, please confirm the system id if there is a second format).
3) Confirmation that Ember accepts the audit record we produce as proof of deletion (we will provide a JSON audit artifact and a ticket link).

If you can attach the signed authorization I will open a privacy removal run ticket with SRE and our Privacy team and request an EU-only scope for the operation. I estimate scheduler availability within 48–72 hours after the ticket is accepted.

If timing is critical, let me know and I can push an earlier window with Marissa and Privacy.
